description: Renovate runs self-hosted, once a night, with the operator's token: every branch it pushes is authored by the operator, which is what the attribution check asks of this repository. Do not set a bot gitAuthor here.

Every update this chart takes is something a person installs, so the shape below is chosen for review rather than volume: a handful of grouped pull requests on Monday morning, majors held, rebased only when they conflict.
Scopes are the chart's own scope-enum: `ci` for the workflows, `oidc` for the Dex fixture under test/, `deps` for the images the chart pins. A scope outside that list is a red pull request.
A release is proposed once it is three days old: long enough for a compromised or yanked publish to be noticed upstream.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A security fix is not held until Monday, and it is a fix, not a chore.

kubernetes.description: The Dex fixture is a plain manifest, which the kubernetes manager only reads from files it is pointed at. config:recommended's ignorePaths would also skip it as a test/ path, which is why ignorePaths above is narrowed to node_modules.

packageRules.description: A dependency bump is a chore unless it is a security fix (vulnerabilityAlerts above).
A major is a migration, not a bump. It waits on the Dependency Dashboard until somebody ticks it.

Valkey is pinned by tag and by digest in values.yaml: the tag is for a reader, the digest is what is pulled. Renovate rewrites both together, and a rebuilt image under the same tag arrives as a digest update - it never leaves a tag without its digest. Docker versioning keeps the -alpine3.24 suffix, so a move to a newer Alpine line is made by hand.
The Dex image of the single sign-on fixture. It is not installed by the chart, only by whoever tries sign-on by hand, so it has its own scope and its own pull request.
The workflows' actions, majors included - a major here is usually a runtime change, and the pull request's own run exercises every one of them.
setup-node's node-version in guards.yml (github-actions extracts it as depName `node`), after the actions rule so that it leaves that group for this one.
